hotels.title: Tamborine Mountain Family-Friendly Lodges in Gold Coast Hinterland for Up To Six Guests
hotels.description: Perched on the lush ridgeline of Tamborine Mountain, just 30 minutes from the Gold Coast and an hour from Brisbane, Edges Lodges is a refined rainforest escape surrounded by serene nature. These beautifully distinct private lodges sit quietly above the Guanaba Gorge, trading city noise for birdsong, mountain breezes and the gentle hush of a waterfall just steps from your deck. When you're ready to venture out, Tamborine Mountain delivers. Pedal its scenic trails on an e-bike, wander the canopy on the Skywalk's breathtaking cantilever bridge or duck into the world's only daytime glow worm sanctuary. Round it out with a pint at the beloved St Bernards Hotel or a cellar door session at O'Reilly's Canungra Valley Vineyards - alpacas included - before heading back to your lodge, with a cosy fireplace and valley views waiting.
